cpu.note: Every figure is a wall-clock duration in this process. stage/compile/rank/openTurn are single observations; the rest are over the configured turn count.
cpu.attribution: turn = 2 x readOwnerAcquire + pluginTurn. readOwnerAcquire is the injected read owner answering (cheap here: it hands over an in-memory snapshot). pluginTurn is Kira validating, ranking, navigating and publishing, and it is dominated by snapshotVerify: the plugin re-derives recordId and contentSha256 for every record in the snapshot on every acquisition, which is the pinned broker's own posture. At this corpus size that is 2 x snapshotVerify per turn; the ranking itself is the much smaller rank figure, and snapshotDigest is the snapshot-key hash that makes invalidation exact.

footprint.vectorNote: The lexical method stores no vectors. The static-embedding, INT8 and ternary options in the migration inventory are NOT implemented and NOT measured here: no encoder is deployed by this build, so their bytes are unknown rather than zero.

process.note: Observed heap delta for building the corpus, index and session in this process. An observation, not a GC-precise retained-size measurement.

descriptive.note: Counts of which status the method returned. This is not an accuracy, quality, or correctness measure, and no generated answer is produced or scored anywhere in this file.
